evidence.observation: Fields: First name, Last name, Street address, Apartment, suite, etc. (optional), City, State (combobox Select/AL..WY), ZIP code, Phone, combobox 'Use this address for' (Shipping and billing / Shipping only / Billing only), checkbox 'Make this my default address', buttons 'Save address', 'Cancel'

Empty submit: no network request; fields marked invalid with 'This field is required.' (first/last name, street, city), 'Choose a state.', 'Enter a 5-digit ZIP code or ZIP+4.', 'Enter a 10-digit US phone number.' Cancel closes form.
